idNote: id is this file's integer, in roster order. It is not Riot's agent number.
usage: Reference only. Not the sim catalog. null means that stat was not in the shared sheet. An object with estimate:true is a sheet (est.) measurement. Do not copy a value into code and call it verified.

globals.allyDamage: Recorded only on the ability whose row states it. The sheet says reduced to allies for Incendiary, Orbital Strike, and Blaze, and it does not give a fraction. Bullets do not damage teammates.
globals.signatureChargeCarry: recharged charges never carry into the next round; unused bought charges do
globals.concussNote: These are the effects set to exactly 2.5s. Other concusses use a different duration.
otherConcuss: Skye Trailblazer: 2.5s at the edge to 4s at the centre
Miks M-pulse: up to 2s per pulse
Hush Displacement: concusses a player pulled into a surface or another player; duration unpublished

nearsightVisionRadiusM.riot1108Note: 11.08 set all four from 5m to 7m. Per-ability radii above are the wiki game-file stats.

combatStim.note: The 11.08 unification block states a reload time modifier of 0.9 and a weapon draw time modifier of 0.9, with fire rate 1.1 and spread recovery 1.1, for Stim Beacon, NULL/cmd, and Empress. The same note also describes a 10% reload-time decrease and a 10% draw-speed increase. A 10% speed increase is a time multiplier of about 0.909, which is not 0.9. Brimstone's +10% movement is separate. Miks and Veto use the sheet's +10% shorthand and were not in that 11.08 list.

twoKillExceptions: Iso Double Tap is a 12s window and a shield orb
